note: Mason County / Western Michigan Fair Association fairgrounds campground, 5302 W US-10, Ludington. An earlier read of the operator's page said the campground is open to the public year-round except fair week and one large horse show; the current page shows only the fair-week registration. Grassy sites. No water body. Distinct from the Mason County Campground on Chauvez Rd. --Claude
summary: Fair association's page confirms 126 grassy sites with 30/50 A, mostly pull-through, four bathhouses with 12 showers; cleared the RoverPass platform (no RoverPass listing for this campground; booking is the fair association's registration form). No nightly rate, season or public (non-fair) camping statement on the current page; season left as derived. Note trimmed of hookup/site/booking text.
flags: No posted nightly rate and no booking engine: the operator's only camping page now offers just the 2026 Western Michigan Fair week registration form ($150 for the fair week), with exhibitor rules ('Exhibitors will camp and sleep only in the camping area', wristbands). Public nightly camping outside fair week is not stated anywhere on masoncountyfairgrounds.com (read 2026-10-22), though an earlier read recorded it as open year-round except fair week and a large horse show. Needs a phone check (231-843-8563) of whether nightly public camping is still sold and at what rate.

Ownership: the campground is run by the Western Michigan Fair Association (a fair association, P.O. Box 153, Scottville), not Mason County; compare 1472 Wayne County Fairgrounds, moved local -> private for the same reason.
